It's a lot to navigate, so I'd suggest starting at the Casino of the Earth—it's the heart of the property! Are you here for a quick overnight trip or a longer stay?

Wombi Rock in the Casino of the Sky is the showstopper. It's a three-story crystal mountain with a lounge on top, all under a massive planetarium dome that shifts from day to night. 

Are you planning to spend most of your time at the tables, or are you looking for a great spot to grab a drink?
